messages: mia: Heads up — docusaurus linkcheck flagged /api/sdk#oauth-flow as missing in the i18n build, but local `yarn start` shows the anchor fine. leah: Is that the page that moved the heading under a Note admonition yesterday? mia: yeah, the heading got demoted from `## OAuth flow` to `#### OAuth flow` inside the admonition. locally the slug is `oauth-flow` but the i18n extractor produced `oauth-flow-1`. raf: repro'd. for translated pages the slug becomes `oauth-flow-1`, so links pointing to `#oauth-flow` 404. looks like a slug collision detection step runs in the i18n pipeline. leo: that matches the customer tickets reporting broken deep links in non-english docs. docs-bot: Linkcheck report: file: docs/api/sdk.md — broken link: /api/sdk#oauth-flow — job: docs-linkcheck-i18n (exit 1) mia: quick fix options: add an explicit MDX id `### OAuth flow {#oauth-flow}` or inject an HTML anchor `` above the heading. leah: prefer MDX id, it's cleaner. but does the i18n extractor preserve `{#id}`? i've seen cases where translation tooling strips braces. raf: good point. safer to add both: an HTML anchor for extractor compatibility and the MDX id for readability. also add a short inline comment so translators know not to remove it. leo: i'll ping i18n team to confirm extractor behavior. we should add a note to the style guide too. mia: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6899 — diff adds `{#oauth-flow}` to the heading and an HTML anchor above it, plus a small test in tests/fixtures/linkcheck/i18n_links.yaml asserting `/api/sdk#oauth-flow` resolves. PR description documents rationale. docs-bot: Running docs-linkcheck on PR 6899... docs-bot: docs-linkcheck-i18n: ✅ passed (0 broken links) deploy-bot: docs preview available: https://deploy-preview-6899--docs.redwood-inference.com/api/sdk#oauth-flow :tada: leah: nice. can we also add a bullet to CONTRIBUTORS.md under "writing docs" about keeping explicit ids for sections that are linked from external apps? mia: done — pushed small CONTRIBUTORS.md update in the same branch with a one-line note. raf: merging once the rest of CI is green. thanks for catching the i18n angle, leo. leo: no prob — will follow up with i18n team to avoid future surprises. :thumbsup:
